module_summary: elfldr/ is the no-IOP-reset child loader (ps2.yaml target elfldr, embedded in the main ELF): it runs from 0x84000, loads the target ELF via rom0:LOADFILE and falls back to a manual fileXio ELF load, optionally resets the IOP / cleans up HDD, then ExecPS2s; it stubs libc symbols to keep newlib out. Launchstation/loader/loader.c carries the same LINKER_ONLY stub block, user-memory wipe and PFS cleanup (cross-repo copy, separate programs). The include/ headers are mostly the private class declarations of the C++ conversion (one singleton per subsystem: AppSource, ArtIndex, BdmLauncher, BdmSupport, HddSupport, MmceSupport, Gui, IoQueue, FontSystem, PadManager, BgmPlayer, ConfigSet) plus shared plain-C headers: extern_irx.h (bin2c IRX blob declarations), iosupport.h (item_list_t, mode/error/exception/compat constants), ds34common.h (DS3/DS4/DS5/ShanWan report layouts shared with the pademu/ds34 IOP modules), pggsm.h (GSM helpers), small static-inline helpers (bdmtyped.h, ilinkid.h, nativevmc.h, disc_key.h). ee_core/tests/ are host tests of the INGAMEDIAG freeze-report formatter and TV page, run by .github/scripts/test_ingame_freeze_diag.py.

reusable_helpers.name: readAll
reusable_helpers.what: loops fileXioRead until size bytes are read or an error/EOF

reusable_helpers.name: wipeUserMem
reusable_helpers.what: zeroes EE user memory from 0x100000 with sq stores, 64 bytes per step

reusable_helpers.name: loadElfViaFileXio
reusable_helpers.what: manual PT_LOAD ELF loader over fileXio with bounds checks and gp from reginfo

reusable_helpers.name: cleanupHddForLaunch
reusable_helpers.what: PFS closeall, sync+umount pfs0..3, idle hdd0/hdd1 and power off dev9 before a handoff

reusable_helpers.name: bdmParseMassSlot
reusable_helpers.what: parses the N out of a mass<N>: path

reusable_helpers.name: bdmFormatTypedPath
reusable_helpers.what: rewrites mass<N>:/x as usb<k>:/x, ilink<k>:/x etc

reusable_helpers.name: nativeVmcSlotWord
reusable_helpers.what: finds and caches a 0xC0DEFAC0+slot marker word in an embedded module image

reusable_helpers.name: translate_pad_shanwan
reusable_helpers.what: converts a 7-byte ShanWan HID report into a DS2 report

reusable_helpers.name: sysReadDiscKey
reusable_helpers.what: synchronous CDVD READ_KEY N-command RPC under the libcdvd semaphore

reusable_helpers.name: IMPORT_BIN2C
reusable_helpers.what: declares a bin2c blob and its size_ symbol

findings.title: DECI2 debug mode (__DECI2_DEBUG) is built by no ps2build configuration: declarations, code paths and 91.6 KB of blobs are dead
findings.problem: __DECI2_DEBUG is defined only by the legacy Makefile (Makefile:84,309-342) and ee_core/Makefile:43-44, and by the -D set in tools/syntax_sweep.py:23. No ps2.yaml target, tools/build_configuration.py or tools/build_edition.py defines it, and deci2/drvtif/tifinet are in no embed_irx list (ps2.yaml:652, build_configuration.py:84-102), so the DECI2 declarations in extern_irx.h, every #ifdef __DECI2_DEBUG block and the five prebuilt blobs are never built or linked.
findings.fix: Delete the five extern_irx.h declarations, the __DECI2_DEBUG blocks in system.cpp, debug.cpp, opl.cpp, system.h and ee_core/src/iopmgr.c (keeping the TTY_UDP/TTY_PPC branches), CORE_IRX_DECI2 if nothing else remains, the DECI2 set in tools/syntax_sweep.py, and the five modules/debug blobs.
findings.benefit: ~110 source lines (sum of cited ranges) and 91,597 bytes of committed blobs (MEASURED: ls -l modules/debug, 73625+5985+5985+3301+3301); no shipped ELF change since no build compiles it (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: git grep -n -i deci2 tools/build_configuration.py tools/build_edition.py ps2.yaml .github/workflows tools/build.py tools/assets.py: no match. git grep DECI2_DEBUG: only Makefile, ee_core/Makefile, tools/syntax_sweep.py:23 (syntax check set), and the #ifdef sites listed. extern_irx.h names deci2_img/drvtif_irx/drvtif_ingame_irx/tifinet_irx/tifinet_ingame_irx are used only inside those #ifdef blocks (system.cpp:317,995-998; debug.cpp:27,32) and legacy Makefile rules. Brief open question 5 raised the same; this confirms it. Other readers own system.cpp/debug.cpp; listed here as the same problem.

findings.title: elfldr/loader.c: duplicated launch tail, repeated error cleanup and an always-true argc test
findings.problem: main() repeats the same 9-line hand-off (cleanupHddForLaunch, resetIOP, SifExitRpc, two FlushCache, paint, ExecPS2) for the LOADFILE and fileXio paths, differing only in where entry/gp come from. loadElfViaFileXio repeats fileXioClose/fileXioExit/return -1 four times. After 'if (argc < 2) return' at 398, 'if (argc > 1)' at 401 is always true.
findings.fix: Set entry/gp from elfdata on LOADFILE success, else from loadElfViaFileXio, and run one shared hand-off tail; use a single fail label for the close/exit/return in loadElfViaFileXio; drop the redundant if (argc > 1) wrapper.
findings.benefit: ~18 source lines; a few dozen bytes off elfldr.elf, which is embedded in the main ELF (INFERRED, not measured).
findings.evidence: Read loader.c in full; lines 448-456 and 462-470 are identical apart from elfdata.epc/elfdata.gp vs entry/gp and the trailing comment; error blocks at 267-269, 275-277, 295-297, 301-303 are identical. Risk Med because this is the boot hand-off path and needs a hardware launch test.

findings.title: pggsm.h: GSM_ARGS, makeSMODE1, makeSYNCH1 and makeSYNCH2 are never used
findings.problem: These four constexpr definitions have no reference anywhere in the repo besides their definitions; only makeSYNCV and makeDISPLAY are used (src/core/gsm.cpp).
findings.fix: Delete GSM_ARGS and the makeSMODE1, makeSYNCH1 and makeSYNCH2 functions.
findings.benefit: 20 source lines; constexpr helpers emit no code, so no ELF change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: git grep -w -o -h -F (names list) over the repo excluding docs/ and third_party/: GSM_ARGS 1, makeSMODE1 1, makeSYNCH1 1, makeSYNCH2 1 (definitions only); makeSYNCV and makeDISPLAY 32 each (pggsm.h + src/core/gsm.cpp).

findings.title: MODE_FLAG_NO_UPDATE is a retired flag that is set in three places and never tested
findings.problem: The macro's own comment says the updater bit is retired. It is OR'd into the APP flags (appsupport.cpp:598, favsupport.cpp:974) and assigned to HttpSource::enabled (httpsupport.cpp:515), but no code tests flags & MODE_FLAG_NO_UPDATE.
findings.fix: Delete the macro, drop it from the two flag expressions, and in HttpSource write the plain nonzero value instead (after checking enabled is only tested for truth), deleting the comment at 513-514.
findings.benefit: ~4 lines and one misleading flag; no size change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: git grep -n NO_UPDATE over src include ee_core modules (excluding MENU_UPD_*): iosupport.h:94, appsupport.cpp:598, favsupport.cpp:974, httpsupport.cpp:513,515 only; no '& MODE_FLAG_NO_UPDATE' test exists. INFERRED part: that HttpSource::enabled is only tested for truth (not checked at every use).

findings.title: elfldr child LAUNCH_DIAG colour markers are permanently compiled out (LAUNCH_DIAG hard-coded 0)
findings.problem: include/launchdiag.h:41 defines LAUNCH_DIAG 0 and no build passes another value (it is a #define, not a -D), so LAUNCHDIAG_CHILD_PAINT is always ((void)0). The block exists for a past UDPBD launch-hang triage build; .github/scripts/test_handoff_probe.py:78-83 only checks that it stays gated.
findings.fix: Delete the child marker block and the three LAUNCHDIAG_CHILD_PAINT calls (and the test_handoff_probe.py check for them); the wider launchdiag feature in include/launchdiag.h and src/platform/launchdiag.cpp is the same dormant switch and belongs to the units that own those files.
findings.benefit: 19 source lines in loader.c; no ELF change since it compiles to nothing (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: git grep -n LAUNCH_DIAG excluding docs: loader.c:140,144,151; include/launchdiag.h:1,2,40,41,52; src/platform/launchdiag.cpp:5; test_handoff_probe.py:78-83. git log include/launchdiag.h shows 'build: LAUNCH_DIAG off for merge' (be17a194).

findings.title: RA_EXPERIMENTAL_CARD_DMA compile switch is always 1 in every build
findings.problem: ra_features.h defaults the switch to 1 under #ifndef and nothing in ps2.yaml, tools/ or workflows defines it; only the host test test_caduceus_overlay.py:118 rewrites it to 0. The user-facing control is the separate gRAExperimentalCards setting.
findings.fix: Delete the macro and its #ifndef block and drop the '&& RA_EXPERIMENTAL_CARD_DMA' / '!RA_EXPERIMENTAL_CARD_DMA ||' terms at the five use sites, together with the compile_disabled case in the host test.
findings.benefit: ~8 source lines and one dead build option; no ELF change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: git grep -n RA_EXPERIMENTAL_CARD_DMA excluding docs: ra_features.h:9-10, ee_core main.c:142, padhook.c:590, ra_overlay.c:369,377, src/app/host.cpp:136, .github/scripts/test_caduceus_overlay.py:15,118. No -D in ps2.yaml, tools/build_edition.py or tools/build_configuration.py.

findings.title: elfldr/Makefile duplicates the ps2.yaml elfldr target and is reached only from the legacy top-level Makefile
findings.problem: The real build compiles elfldr from ps2.yaml:615-624 (same source, defines, gc-sections and linkfile). elfldr/Makefile is invoked only by the legacy top-level Makefile (Makefile:429 clean, :579-584 bin2c rule), which is not the build.
findings.fix: Delete elfldr/Makefile together with the legacy Makefile tree (or now, if the legacy Makefile is being retired piecewise).
findings.benefit: 27 lines of build clutter; no shipped change.
findings.evidence: git grep -n elfldr in Makefile *.py *.yml *.yaml: Makefile:136,429,579,583-584 and ps2.yaml:615-624,646,652; no workflow or tools script runs make in elfldr/ (brief section 2: only modules/bdmassault/ilink_bd_assault uses make in CI).

findings.title: disc_key.h defines sysReadDiscKey as static inline with static RPC buffers, so two translation units each get their own copy
findings.problem: The header is included and called in system.cpp and sysdisc.cpp, so the function body and its 64-byte request and 64-byte response buffers (both 64-byte aligned statics) are emitted twice in the main ELF.
findings.fix: Make sysReadDiscKey an ordinary function defined once (for example in sysdisc.cpp) and leave only its prototype and the libcdvd externs in disc_key.h.
findings.benefit: 128 B .bss (2 x 64-byte static arrays, INFERRED) plus one copy of a ~20-line function (~100-150 B .text, INFERRED); no lines removed.
findings.evidence: git grep disc_key.h: src/platform/sysdisc.cpp:7, src/platform/system.cpp:7 (and the host test test_disc_key_semaphore.py:14, which compiles the header and would need the definition too). git grep -w sysReadDiscKey: system.cpp:527, sysdisc.cpp:230. INFERRED part: that the compiler does not merge the two copies (no LTO in ps2.yaml).

findings.title: Stale comments in elfldr/loader.c, fontsystem.h, ioqueue.h and iosupport.h name files, flavours and plans that no longer exist
findings.problem: loader.c:24-30 justifies the LOADFILE-first order by the '-WOPLSDK flavour', which no workflow or tool builds any more; loader.c:140 names src/launchdiag.c (now src/platform/launchdiag.cpp); fontsystem.h:6 and ioqueue.h:6 name src/fntsys.cpp and src/ioman.cpp (now src/gfx/ and src/platform/); iosupport.h:22-24 marks MMCE_MODE, FAV_MODE and UDPFS_MODE as 'reserved ... returns with checklist item', but mmcesupport.cpp, favsupport.cpp and udpfssupport.cpp are implemented.
findings.fix: Delete the stale wording (keep one line in loader.c saying LOADFILE stays first for ioman-visible devices) and correct the two file paths.
findings.evidence: git grep -n -i 'woplsdk' .github/workflows tools ps2.yaml: no match (only modules/freepad/PROVENANCE.md and loader.c). ls: src/gfx/fntsys.cpp, src/platform/ioman.cpp, src/platform/launchdiag.cpp, src/sources/mmcesupport.cpp, favsupport.cpp, udpfssupport.cpp exist; src/launchdiag.c does not.
